How the numbers work

Out-the-door price

  • Vehicle price as listed, less the $700 family discount on Enterprise cars (not yet confirmed with the store).
  • Dealer fees: Enterprise Wayne $350 documentary fee; other Enterprise stores $399 plus the transfer fee to Wayne; other dealers $899 to $995 as posted.
  • NJ sales tax 6.625% on price plus dealer fees.
  • NJ title $60 paid in cash, $85 with a loan. Registration about $80 (varies by weight).

Financing at a 725 credit score

  • Tier: 725 is "prime" (661 to 780).
  • Rate: Experian's Q1 2026 average used-car APR for prime borrowers is 8.77%; the default here is 8.75%.
  • Credit unions often quote 1 to 2 points lower. Get a pre-approval and change the APR box to match.
  • Minimum down: prime borrowers are commonly approved with $0 down; tax and fees are then rolled into the loan. Change the box if a lender asks for more.
  • Payment = standard fixed-rate amortization on (out-the-door price minus down payment).
